audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Mary anointing, Lazarus witness, Jerusalem entry, Greeks seeking Jesus, grain of wheat, love/hate life, lifted up, Isaiah unbelief texts, final public appeal.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore, six days before Passover, came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

familiar.text: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

verses.restored: They made him a dinner there, and Martha was serving; Lazarus was one of those reclining with him.

familiar.text: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

verses.restored: Mary therefore, taking a pound of costly ointment of pure nard, anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

familiar.text: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

verses.restored: Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples, the one about to hand him over, says,

familiar.text: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,

verses.restored: Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred denarii and given to poor people?

familiar.text: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

verses.restored: He said this not because it mattered to him about the poor, but because he was a thief; having the money box, he used to carry what was put into it.

familiar.text: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore said, Leave her, so that she may keep it for the day of my burial.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

verses.restored: For poor people you always have with you, but me you do not always have.

familiar.text: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

verses.restored: A great crowd of the Judeans therefore knew that he was there, and they came not because of Jesus only, but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

familiar.text: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.restored: The chief priests took counsel that they might also kill Lazarus,

familiar.text: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

verses.restored: because on account of him many of the Judeans were going away and trusting into Jesus.

familiar.text: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

verses.restored: On the next day, the great crowd that had come to the feast, hearing that Jesus was coming into Jerusalem,

familiar.text: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

verses.restored: took palm branches and went out to meet him, and were crying out, Hosanna. Blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel.

familiar.text: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.restored: Jesus, finding a young donkey, sat on it, just as it has been written,

familiar.text: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

verses.restored: Do not fear, daughter of Zion; look, your king comes, sitting on a donkey's colt.

familiar.text: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

verses.restored: His disciples did not know these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.

familiar.text: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

verses.restored: The crowd therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was bearing witness.

familiar.text: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

verses.restored: Because of this also the crowd met him, because they heard he had done this sign.

familiar.text: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

verses.restored: The Pharisees therefore said to themselves, You see that you accomplish nothing; look, the world has gone after him.

familiar.text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

verses.restored: Now there were some Greeks among those going up to worship at the feast.

familiar.text: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

verses.restored: These therefore came to Philip, the one from Bethsaida of Galilee, and were asking him, saying, Lord, we wish to see Jesus.

familiar.text: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

verses.restored: Philip comes and tells Andrew; Andrew and Philip come and tell Jesus.

familiar.text: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

verses.restored: Jesus answers them, saying, The hour has come for the Son of Humanity to be glorified.

familiar.text: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: unless the grain of wheat falling into the earth dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

verses.restored: The one loving one's life/soul loses it, and the one hating one's life/soul in this world will guard it into age-long life.

familiar.text: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

verses.restored: If anyone serves me, let that one follow me; and where I am, there also my servant will be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor that one.

familiar.text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

verses.restored: Now my soul/life has been troubled, and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour? But because of this I came to this hour.

familiar.text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

verses.restored: Father, glorify your name. Then a voice came from heaven: I have both glorified it and will glorify again.

familiar.text: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

verses.restored: The crowd therefore standing and hearing said it had thundered; others said, A messenger has spoken to him.

familiar.text: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said, This voice has not happened because of me, but because of you.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

verses.restored: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast outside.

familiar.text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

verses.restored: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all to myself.

familiar.text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

verses.restored: He was saying this signifying by what kind of death he was about to die.

familiar.text: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

verses.restored: The crowd answered him, We heard from the Law that the Messiah remains into the age; how do you say that the Son of Humanity must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Humanity?

familiar.text: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

verses.restored: Jesus therefore said to them, Yet a little time the light is among you. Walk while you have the light, so that darkness may not overtake you; the one walking in darkness does not know where one goes.

familiar.text: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

verses.restored: While you have the light, trust into the light, so that you may become children of light. Jesus spoke these things, and going away, he was hidden from them.

familiar.text: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

verses.restored: Though he had done so many signs before them, they were not trusting into him,

familiar.text: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

verses.restored: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he said: Lord, who trusted our report? And the arm of the Lord, to whom was it revealed?

familiar.text: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

verses.restored: Because of this they were not able to trust, because again Isaiah said,

familiar.text: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

verses.restored: He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they might not see with the eyes and understand with the heart and turn, and I would heal them.

familiar.text: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

verses.restored: Isaiah said these things because he saw his glory and spoke concerning him.

familiar.text: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

verses.restored: Nevertheless, even from the rulers many trusted into him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing, so that they would not be put out of the synagogue.

familiar.text: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

verses.restored: For they loved the glory of humans more than the glory of the Divine.

familiar.text: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

verses.restored: Jesus cried out and said, The one trusting into me trusts not into me but into the One who sent me.

familiar.text: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

verses.restored: And the one beholding me beholds the One who sent me.

familiar.text: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

verses.restored: I have come as light into the world, so that everyone trusting into me may not remain in darkness.

familiar.text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

verses.restored: If anyone hears my words and does not guard them, I do not judge that one; for I did not come to judge the world, but to save/heal the world.

familiar.text: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

verses.restored: The one rejecting me and not receiving my words has one judging that one: the word I spoke, that will judge that one on the last day.

familiar.text: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

verses.restored: Because I did not speak from myself, but the Father who sent me has himself given me command, what I should say and what I should speak.

familiar.text: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

verses.restored: And I know that his command is age-long life. Therefore what I speak, just as the Father has said to me, so I speak.

familiar.text: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
